Snow & Weather Notes

SNOW & WEATHER NOTES:
Lookout Pass is CLOSED Thanksgiving day – So our employees can enjoy time with family. 
Thursday 11/26/2026 Temps: Lo 32 – Hi 38 – Snow ~ 1/2″ at 5,500 ft and up . Wind: 5 mph SW.
Snow Levels drop into the 4,000 ft level on Sat., Sun., and Monday. 
Slopes CLOSED till more snow arrives. Look here for an Opening Day announcement. We are close just need a bit more snow, especially in the base.  
Keep doing your Snow Dances.
